Medium upright ears (not tiny British ears), narrower smiling muzzle, tall sturdy rectangular torso noticeably taller than broad British loaf. Preserve Mobby unified rounded-square head/body NO neck or separate head, short arms/two short feet and side tail. One black cross D-pad lower LEFT belly and exactly TWO PLAIN unmarked black round buttons diagonally lower RIGHT. No paw marks on buttons. True transparent alpha PNG exact1254x1254. Whole character occupies only80% of canvas with at least100px empty transparent border on all sides.
